svg.desc: Transparent Charity, Milestone-verified donation escrow on Ethereum. Web3. Built with Solidity, Express, PostgreSQL, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Funds release in tranches only when an independent verifier approves evidence for that milestone, with the full history, rejections included, public forever. https://github.com/rokadepiyush49-rgb/transparent-charity-blockchain
